explorer.description: Map files, symbols, and call paths without editing.

vision.description: Inspect screenshots and visual evidence without editing.

analyst.description: Resolve requirements, acceptance criteria, and bounded ambiguity.

planner.description: Sequence delivery work with clear ownership and acceptance checks.

docs-researcher.description: Research current primary documentation and report source evidence.

worker.description: Implement a bounded outcome with proportionate verification.

test-engineer.description: Add meaningful tests for observable behavior and concrete failure risk.

git-master.description: Manage authorized Git delivery and verify repository state.

architect.description: Review system boundaries, interfaces, and durable architectural choices.

designer.description: Define product interactions and implementation-ready visual direction.

debugger.description: Find the root cause from evidence before proposing a correction.

reviewer.description: Independently review integrated correctness, regressions, and maintainability.

security-reviewer.description: Review concrete trust boundaries and security risks.

browser-debugger.description: Investigate browser behavior with task-owned fixtures and evidence.

build-fixer.description: Repair build, dependency, compiler, and packaging failures.

code-simplifier.description: Simplify changed code while preserving observable behavior.

verifier.description: Verify outcome claims using focused checks and runtime evidence.

instruction: Read AGENTS.md and docs/engineering/testing-policy.md. Follow current task authority, preserve unrelated work, and report implementation, validation, review, delivery, and acceptance separately. Use task-owned fixtures and resources.
